config.quality_weight_form: gain = cosine distance to the nearest chosen point x location P(>=4) ** quality_weight

ceiling.acts: the seating leg, sequentially in the slots' walk order
ceiling.allowance: floor(k * t_c * n) + 1, n = seats filled including this one
ceiling.reject: only a candidate that is itself DOMINANT in an over-allowance cell or family
ceiling.dominance: chromatic share per codebook cell, neutrals out of the numerator and the denominator. A cell is DOMINANT when it is the largest chromatic cell and holds >= 0.1, or when it holds >= 0.15 on its own; a picture may have more than one and may have none. The same rule over codebook.rollup families at 0.2 / 0.3. No floor on the raw share.
ceiling.metric: sliced Wasserstein-1 between two pictures' pixel clouds: 4096 pixels of each render at the codebook census size, sRGB8 to Oklab, a and b scaled by 4.0 so a hue difference counts that many times a lightness difference, projected onto 1024 directions of a Fibonacci half-sphere lattice and read at 128 evenly spaced quantiles. All pixels, neutrals included.

identity.holds: the walk's gate render is byte-identical to this location's tile at this regime, so the head is asked about the picture it was trained on
